description: Change an appointment already in the user's calendar: move it, rename it, add or drop a reminder, start or stop it repeating. It names appointments by the id from mnemosyne_agenda_list, so call that first. A field you leave out is left alone, and passing null clears it. A start or end time that cannot be read refuses the change rather than leaving the old one quietly in place. A cadence outside daily, weekly, monthly and yearly is refused rather than turned into a one-off. Works with the app closed on a dev install (the headless daemon reads the file); an npm install has no daemon and needs the app running. Scope agenda:write.

changes.description: One entry per appointment. Up to 50 per call.

alarm_minutes_before.description: Minutes before the start a reminder rings; null removes the reminder. Changing only this keeps the existing ring sound and volume.

all_day.description: Day marker with no specific time.

end.description: New end, ISO 8601. null makes it a point in time rather than a block.

event_id.description: The appointment id, exactly as mnemosyne_agenda_list printed it in brackets.

recurrence.description: daily / weekly / monthly / yearly, or null to STOP repeating (which also drops the series end date, since it would describe a series that no longer exists).

start.description: New start, ISO 8601. No timezone offset = the HUMAN'S OWN machine local time, never UTC.

name: mnemosyne_agenda_update
